import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

LANE = Path('/Users/jess/git/video-utils/.local/sprint2/fuller_profile')
MAIN = Path('/Users/jess/git/video-utils')
RUN_DIR = MAIN / 'artifacts/runs/20261006T041633Z-990aa1bd6737'
PREVIEW = MAIN / 'artifacts/runs/20261006T034521Z-a0def0c43eac/reference-marked-preview-compact'
SELECTOR = 'arrangement-reference-20261006/arrangement-markers.json'
OUTPUT = 'artifacts/s2/fuller_profile/A2-marked-compact'
RECEIPT = LANE / 'docs/agent-notes/sprints/20261006-s2/fuller_profile-A2.json'

ACCEPTED_COMPACT = FREEZE['accepted_truth']['accepted_compact_marked_video_sha256']


def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b''):
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()


def protected():
    return {name: (sha(name) if Path(name).is_file() else None) for name in FREEZE['protected_before_sha256']}


started = time.monotonic()
before = protected()
command = [sys.executable, str(LANE / 'scripts/marked_compact.py'), str(RUN_DIR), '--picture-preview', str(PREVIEW),
           '--arrangement-markers', SELECTOR, '--output', OUTPUT, '--timeout-seconds', '600']
result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=LANE, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=630)

          'composite_visual_review_performed', 'composite_listening_review', 'markers_are_analysis_of_audio_branch',
          'performance_issue_confirmed', 'note_correctness_assessed', 'master_adopted', 'latest_promoted',
          'default_profile_changed_by_lane', 'native_editor_import_verified', 'listening_acceptance',
          'accepted_audio_identity', 'tone_suitability_other_takes')
ok = result.returncode == 0 and tool.get('status') == 'marked_compact_composition_verified'
primary = {'tool_status': tool.get('status'), 'reason': tool.get('reason'),
           'video_packets_identical': tool.get('video_packets_identical'),
           'aac_packets_identical': tool.get('aac_packets_identical'),
           'video_packets_expected': '3621/3621', 'aac_packets_expected': '6503/6503',
           'chain_class': (tool.get('chain_identity') or {}).get('chain_class'),
           'listening_acceptance': tool.get('listening_acceptance'),
           'markers_are_analysis_of_audio_branch': tool.get('markers_are_analysis_of_audio_branch')}
primary['pass'] = (ok and primary['video_packets_identical'] == '3621/3621' and primary['aac_packets_identical'] == '6503/6503'
                   and primary['listening_acceptance'] == 'accepted_fuller_v1_by_operator_2026-10-06'
                   and primary['markers_are_analysis_of_audio_branch'] is False)
receipt = {'schema_version': 1, 'lane': 'fuller_profile', 'sprint': '20261006-s2', 'linear': 'TIN-5600',
           'experiment': 'A2', 'authority': 'S2 lane contract; R-HOOK-CONVERGENCE-20261004 / R-N11 / R-N13',
           'preregistration': 'docs/spec/sprints/FULLER_S2.md section 9 (sealed in b4e0196)',
           'sealed_predictions': {k: v for k, v in FREEZE['sealed_predictions'].items() if k.startswith('A2')},
           'recorded_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
           'driver_sha256': sha(__file__), 'controller_sha256': sha(LANE / 'scripts/marked_compact.py'),
           'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout[-4000:],
           'stderr': result.stderr[-4000:], 'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - started,
           'tool_receipt': str(tool_receipt_path), 'tool_receipt_sha256': sha(tool_receipt_path) if tool_receipt_path.is_file() else None,
           'primary': primary,
           'secondary': {'output_sha256': tool.get('output_sha256'), 'accepted_compact_sha256': ACCEPTED_COMPACT,
                         'byte_identical_to_accepted_compact': tool.get('output_sha256') == ACCEPTED_COMPACT,
                         'output_bytes': tool.get('output_bytes'),
                         'scope': 'Secondary is reported, not scored as failure, when packet and PCM identity pass.'},
           'decoded_aac_pcm_sha256': tool.get('decoded_aac_pcm_sha256'),
           'chain_identity': tool.get('chain_identity'),
           'protected_before_sha256': before, 'protected_after_sha256': after,
           'protected_before_matches_freeze': before == FREEZE['protected_before_sha256'],
           'protected_unchanged': before == after,
           'tool_input_hashes_preserved': tool.get('input_hashes_preserved'),
           'tool_protected_file_count': len(tool.get('input_sha256') or {}),
           'output_location': 'gitignored lane artifacts/s2/fuller_profile/A2-marked-compact',
           'listening_scope': 'No new listening occurred. The audio-branch label follows the identical-chain and byte-identical-audio rule; the composite has no visual or listening review.',
           **{key: tool.get(key) for key in fields}}
RECEIPT.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'returncode': result.returncode, 'primary': primary, 'secondary_identical': receipt['secondary']['byte_identical_to_accepted_compact'],
